scope.description: Vendors competing with Freematica e-Satellite for private-security companies' ERP, rostering, guard-app and payroll budgets in Spain, Mexico and Colombia.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: the global security workforce-management leader, Spanish security ERPs named in Spanish market overviews, Dynamics 365-based security ERPs, and a Colombian security ERP. Excluded: zvoove's own brands (e.g. Planbition, which also serves security firms).
scope.notes: Most Spanish and LatAm vendors are private and publish no metrics. Trackforce figures are company-reported and global.
